description: This file defines the MessageDataBuffer class within the Thunder::Messaging namespace, which manages inter-process communication buffers using cyclic buffers and doorbells for signaling. It includes nested classes, methods for data push/pop, synchronization, and filename preparation for message storage.

classes.name: MessageDataBuffer
classes.description: Manages message buffers with signaling via doorbells, providing methods for data push, pop, and buffer management.

classes.name: MessageDataBuffer::DataBuffer
classes.description: Nested class extending CyclicBuffer, handling data signaling and size calculations.

methods.name: MessageDataBuffer::MessageDataBuffer
methods.description: Constructor initializing buffer filenames, synchronization primitives, and buffer state.

methods.name: MessageDataBuffer::~MessageDataBuffer
methods.description: Destructor that releases resources and unlinks buffers if initialized as server.

methods.name: MessageDataBuffer::Name
methods.description: Returns the data filename associated with the buffer.

methods.name: MessageDataBuffer::PushData
methods.description: Writes data into the cyclic buffer and signals the other side.

methods.name: MessageDataBuffer::PopData
methods.description: Reads data from the buffer after a doorbell ring, handling partial messages.

methods.name: MessageDataBuffer::Wait
methods.description: Waits for the doorbell signal within a specified timeout.

methods.name: MessageDataBuffer::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is valid.
